0022600041.text: Sacramento hosts Portland in the Kings' 12th game of the season and their Emirates NBA Cup West Group C matchup, with the Kings at 1-10 overall, 0-6 at home, on a four-game losing streak, and 14th in the West. The Trail Blazers are 7-3 with a one-game win streak, 3rd in the Northwest and 8th in the West. Sacramento is without Ben Simmons (Achilles, surgery) and Maxime Raynaud (knee, dislocated), and Precious Achiuwa is day-to-day with a lower leg bruise and is a game-time decision, while Portland is missing Chris Youngblood (foot bruise), Ja Morant (hamstring), Shaedon Sharpe (knee, surgery), and Vit Krejci (ankle). The Kings trail the 2026-27 season series 0-1 after losing 128-120 in Sacramento on October 23, and they lost the 2025-26 series 0-4.
